structured_output.summary: The law gives a single joint return with WV taxable income of $84,928: the spouse's $88,928 of wages less two $2,000 exemptions. The VA benefits are federally exempt, so they never enter AGI. SB 392 enacted W. Va. Code §11-21-4j, which cuts rates for tax year 2026 and was effective before the freeze. Under its schedule the tax is $1,950.50 + 4.58% × $24,928 = $3,092.19. The engine applied exactly these steps; its $88,927.65 AGI is float rounding. The consensus figure of $3,255.03 uses the superseded 2025 rates (2.22% to 4.82%).
